Introduction
This IG serves as the authoritative index to the Additional Resources permitted for use in FHIR exchanges for version 6.0 and above. It also provides a listing of the 'incubator' implementation guides that define these resources. Incubators are guides that define content intended for eventual inclusion in the FHIR core specification but do not yet have the maturity to meet the requirements for normative.
NOTE: Incubator content with a maturity level of Standard for Trial Use (STU) or higher is intended for use in production systems and can (and should) be leveraged where appropriate for interoperability use-cases. However, this content is subject to Substantive or Breaking changes. In some cases, a determination may be made to deprecate incubator content rather than progressing it to the FHIR core specification. In these cases, the content will be retained in its respective incubator IG and flagged as deprecated.
